Lottie C.Google review

Firstly is the most Dean approachable contractor I have ever worked with and I do for a living! When we reached out to him about the difficulty we were having making a sale with my mum‘s loft (spray foam insulation) he was honest and open and keen to help. Having to do everything remotely from 300 miles away was a real challenge, but Dean and his team did everything possible to make it work. The loft had closed cell insulation onto a non-breathable membrane. We had quotes from so many people and none of them were the same (some promising things that were cheaply priced around 3k but sounded unrealistic and only when pressed did we hear things like “50% success rate” and then bigger price tags emerging- up to 25k!) We were recommended Dean by a surveyor who had seen his Work previously and said it was the best cleanest Work he had seen and there were no problems getting a mortgage once he had done the work. Dean was the 1st to provide us with clear evidence of the testing he done. He showed us why we couldn’t have ice blasting without damaging the roof. He explained what was needed was a full removal and replacement - we went for a new roof with dark tiles as this had looked very good on neighbouring properties. His pricing was very fair and reasonable for the work he proposed. Dean answered so many calls with many questions and always dealt with things personally. They repaired anything that needed it along the way and did a fantastic job tidying up knowing we are trying to sell. The roof looks amazing and we felt genuinely supported every step of the way. The work was completed very fast and they were very popular with the neighbours, they started a new roof trend on the street- everybody wanted one! We are very hopeful that we get a sale quickly now this is done and will update this review following that with how it went with his guarantee and the surveyors etc. Overall Dean and his team were true lifesavers.

Paul T.Google review

We contacted Next Generation Insulation having read very positive reviews for their work on spray foam removal. We have not been disappointed and they lived up to their reputation. From our initial contact with Dean, who came out on a Sunday morning, we had immediate trust in him. He inspected the loft and confirmed our concerns with the foam insulation, gave us recommendations but did not push. A fair quote was received within two days and no deposit was requested. Andy, David and Jay carried out the spray foam removal but found extensive damage to the felting beneath. Further inspection showed rotting lathes and tile slippage. Consequently a roof repair job was urgently required. Scaffolding was arranged immediately and plans were made to secure the roof. They worked tirelessly to replace membrane and lathes in terrible conditions and did not stop, even when soaked, to make the roof watertight for the weekend. The whole job of roof repair and re insulation to a high standard was completed within a further two days, seven in total. We were kept informed with progress at every stage. We cannot thank the team enough, including Luke, for their work ethic, diligence and good humour. Our recommendation for this company is completely unreserved - they are amazing.

Sammy B.Google review

I live in an old cottage and called out Next Generation to look at removing the spray foam I had in the loft. They gave a very thorough assessment of the work involved and the cost and time frame, which I accepted. After a short while Next Gen discovered that there the water proof membrane below the roof tiles was disintegrating and the one of the purlin supporting the roof had almost rotted away and needed to be replaced. They could have ignored these problems and just removed the spray foam, but thankfully they didn't. The work required to sort these problems out was quite extensive and Next Gen gave me priority in getting the work done which took a couple of weeks. They did the work at the revised price and on time and the men involved were extremely friendly and tidy. I would highly recommend Next Generation.
